title: Inventory manager counts 20 more Office Chairs than recorded and applies the row's count: stock is corrected through one adjustment move
_seedNote: demo seed: stock levels for Desk Combination (row 1, sorted by product) and Office Chair (row 2) at WH/Stock. Counts 20 above what is recorded, so every run makes one adjustment move; also tops the chairs up so J-SALES-01 yields a Ready delivery on a re-run.

seeds.name: counted
seeds.sql: SELECT CAST(l.Quantity + 20 AS INTEGER) AS n FROM Inventory.StockLevel AS l WHERE l/Inventory.StockLevel_Product/Products.Product/InternalReference = 'FURN_0269' AND l/Inventory.StockLevel_Location/Inventory.Location/Name = 'WH/Stock'

steps.name: Open Inventory > Stock: both stock levels are listed
Count {{counted}} Office Chairs and press the row's Apply

actions.label: Apply (Office Chair row) — straight after typing, as a user would

oql.label: an adjustment move for the chairs is done
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(m.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.StockMove AS m WHERE m.IsInventoryAdjustment = true AND m.Status = 'Done' AND m/Inventory.StockMove_Product/Products.Product/InternalReference = 'FURN_0269'

outcome.label: {{counted}} Office Chairs on hand at WH/Stock, the count cleared
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(l.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.StockLevel AS l WHERE l/Inventory.StockLevel_Product/Products.Product/InternalReference = 'FURN_0269' AND l.Quantity = {{counted}} AND l.CountedQuantity = NULL
